data.indexFullNameCn: 中证全指半导体产品与设备指数
data.indexFullNameEn: CSI All Share Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指半导体产品与设备指数从中证全指指数样本中选取业务涉及半导体产品和半导体设备等领域的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映半导体产品与设备上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI All Share Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment Index selects securities of listed companies from the universe of CSI All Share Index whose business involves in the fields of semiconductor products and equipment as index constituents. The index is to reflect the overall performance of securities of listed companies in the semiconductor products and equipment area.
